verdict.rationale: Runpod is a GPU cloud, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it offers scheduled or triggered background automations, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no first-party automation, scheduling, or trigger feature. The REST API is described as something to integrate "into your applications, workflows, and automation systems." That is a developer building block. The agent skills and MCP servers let an external agent create Pods on demand, which is user-side orchestration. Long-running SSH processes and serverless scale-to-zero are infrastructure behaviors, not autonomous automations the user sets up.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
